storage: Airtight jar in a cool, dry cupboard for 6 to 12 months; keep it dry in the monsoon. Soaked beans keep about a day in the fridge; cooked dal makhani keeps 2 to 3 days chilled and freezes well.
looksLike: Small, shiny, oval black beans, creamy white inside. They are not the same as the white skinned whole urad (urad gota) or the split white dal used for idli and dosa batter.
howToPick: Look for uniform, glossy black seeds with no white or brown patches, no holes, no dust and no musty smell. Check the label says "whole black" (sabut or kali), not urad gota (skinned, white).
shelfLife: About 6 to 12 months in a sealed pack (check the best-before date).
substitutes: Urad chilka (split black urad with skin)

usedIn.raw: 40 g raw whole black gram per serving (about 3 level tbsp), alongside 10 g rajma
